article_context: The body image supports the section about three distinct panoramic outlooks from one apartment. Its local caption and surrounding text emphasize an expansive view over green parks toward Moscow landmarks, together with abundant natural light.
image_reading: A wide, elevated panorama shows an autumn park with ponds and a fountain in the foreground, dense residential districts beyond, and a bright hazy sky.
The broad layered composition leads from trees and water to the distant skyline; foliage, fountain spray, pond surfaces, and sparse road traffic are visibly capable of natural motion.

models.positive_prompt: A gentle breeze travels steadily across the park canopy as the fountain spray drifts and pond surfaces softly ripple. Slowly push toward the green park and distant skyline; by the final frame, the moving band of foliage has reached the far trees while the expansive panorama remains clear.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, a moderate breeze advances continuously from the near trees through the park toward the distant tree line, expressed by sequential swaying foliage, lightly drifting fountain spray, and restrained ripples on the ponds. The camera makes one slow forward push with the park and skyline as its focal target. The motion develops evenly and ends with the breeze visibly reaching the far canopy while the full urban panorama remains open and recognizable.

models.positive_prompt: The breeze sweeps from the foreground trees across the autumn park, gently shifting the fountain mist and rippling the ponds. Make a subtle forward drift toward the park; in the final frame, the far canopy is moving softly beneath the unobstructed skyline.
models.scene_plan: For four seconds, focus on a compact wave of wind crossing the autumn foliage from foreground to background, with fountain mist and water ripples responding as part of the same airflow. Use a subtle forward camera drift aimed at the central park. Near the end, the wind reaches the far canopy, which continues moving gently beneath a clear, continuously visible skyline.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation reinforces the apartment's valuable panoramic outlook over green parkland toward the wider Moscow cityscape.
structured_intent.primary_action: A gentle breeze travels across the park canopy from the foreground toward the distant trees.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The view remains an expansive, sunlit panorama that connects abundant greenery with the surrounding city.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The breeze has visibly reached the far tree canopy while the full park-and-city panorama remains unobstructed.
